messages.author: 89bb0c49846bdd90
messages.subject: Error in read.capthist(),  :   requires single 'captfile'
parts:
Hi everyone!

I am just getting started with secr and cannot get past the read.capthist function.

I have been troubleshooting for a few days with the example data from the Flat-tailed horned lizard study.
The data imports correctly, but each time I try to use the function I receive the error message "requires single 'captfile'."

Here is the code I am using. 
read.capthist(FTHLcapt, FTHLtrap, detector = 'polygon', fmt =c('XY'), skip=1) or 
read.capthist(FTHLcapt, FTHLtrap, detector = 'polygon', fmt =c('XY')) 

Error in read.capthist(FTHLcapt, FTHLtrap, detector = "polygon", fmt = c("XY"),  :
  requires single 'captfile'

Thank you for any help!
Carson M

messages.author: 359f1d69975617d6
messages.subject: Re: Error in read.capthist(), : requires single 'captfile'
parts:
Hey Carson,

seems like you haven't defined/imported the capture file correctly. I assume it will be the same for the trap file.

Given your working directory is set to the folder containing the secr example data, you could try:
CH <- read.capthist(captfile = "FTHLcapt.txt", trapfile = "FTHLtrap.txt", fmt = "XY", detector = "polygon", skip = 1)
summary(CH)

Lukas
